**Inferred:** Expanding the matrix to `[1, 2]` later would still run shard 1 twice unless the command is fixed — undermines the stated rollout intent.

Use `--shard-id=${{ matrix.shard }}`, add shard `2` to the matrix (or keep a non-sharded full run elsewhere that the gate records), then re-run the suite comparison at this head.
